verdict.rationale: Lovable's collaboration docs describe inviting teammates to build together with live visibility of changes. Each collaborator can also work in a separate draft of the same project, and workspaces span multiple projects with shared skills. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-user collaboration, and detailed role/permission documentation for workspace members.

support.subject: As a founder, my team can work on the same project together in a shared workspace

citations.quote: Lovable lets you build websites together. Invite your designer, developer, agency, or anyone else. Everyone sees changes as they happen.
When several people build in the same project, each of you can work in your own draft: a separate copy of the project with its own chat and preview.
Define a skill once at the workspace level, and Lovable can use it across every project in that workspace.
